title_phrases: hide and seek animal sounds for toddlers
episode.description_intro: Join Dino in a rainbow hide and seek adventure! Learn animal sounds for kids as Dino finds horse, duck, cat, rooster, bird, sheep, and cow hiding under the rainbow.
learning_points: Animal names: horse, duck, cat, rooster, bird, sheep, cow
Animal sounds: neigh, quack, meow, cock-a-doodle-doo, tweet, baa, moo

hook: Wow! Look at that big rainbow!
My friends are hiding under it!
episode.ask: Can you help me find them?

finds.action_line: The horse can stomp! Can you stomp too?
The duck can flap! Can you flap too?
The cat can spin! Can you spin too?
The rooster can flap! Can you flap too?
The sheep can wiggle! Can you wiggle too?
The cow can dance! Can you dance too?
The bird can hop! Can you hop too?

lines: Hop and jump and stomp your feet
Clap your hands and wave now
Flap your wings and march along
Stretch up high to the sky
Hop and clap and wiggle around

finale: Thank you for finding all my friends!
Thank you, friends! I love you!
episode.teaser_line: Next time, a new friend comes to play!
